description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade and check functions for the i.MX Cortex-A9 architecture within the OpenWrt project. It defines functions to check image compatibility, perform upgrades, and manage configuration copying tailored to specific hardware boards.

methods.name: enable_image_metadata_check
methods.description: Enables image metadata verification for specific board models.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the provided image is compatible with the current hardware board.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process tailored to the hardware board, selecting the appropriate upgrade method.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies the configuration to the device before upgrade if applicable.

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Performs any required steps prior to upgrading, such as preparing storage.
